turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Good morning, Adrian Lim. This is Clara Lee speaking. Thank you for calling. Are you somewhere you can speak comfortably, or would you prefer to arrange a telephone appointment?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Good morning, Clara. I'm in my office with the door closed, so now is convenient. I prefer brief calls between meetings. I've brought my notes, although they are rather untidy. My identification number is G three nine zero four five five two I. Sorry, I've spotted an error in my notes; my correct identification number is G three zero zero four five five two I. My date of birth is the twenty-first of March nineteen ninety-five.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you for correcting your notes as we go. We can keep the conversation focused. Before we turn to the investment discussion, is there any account correspondence administration you wanted to raise?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Electronic correspondence is much more convenient for me than post. I'm often away from the office, and paper tends to sit unopened until my assistant gathers it together. I'd rather retrieve documents myself when I need them.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: We can discuss the correspondence arrangements without involving your assistant. You can also use the secure messaging service for administrative enquiries. Turning to the investment discussion, I recommend buying Orion Global Income Fund.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Let me refer to the rest of my notes. The fund I want to transact in is Orion Global Income Fund. I want to buy the fund units.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I've noted that your investment objective is to build a source of income while maintaining a diversified portfolio.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I've set aside the paperwork so I won't have to search for it during the call. Please take me through the matters you need to cover.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: With Orion Global Income Fund, rising market interest rates can reduce the value of the bonds it holds and cause its unit value to fall. Do you understand how rising interest rates could affect the fund's holdings and its unit value?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I understand that rising interest rates can lower the value of the bonds held by the fund and reduce its unit value.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: You could lose some or all of the capital you invest in this fund. Are you willing to accept investment losses on this investment?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I am willing to bear investment losses, although I prefer less volatile investments.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I'll move on to the charge information. The transaction charge is 1,500 Japanese yen.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: For the transaction charge only, please debit my separate account in Japanese yen, not the account funding the purchase. Please use euros for the fund purchase. The amount I want to commit to the purchase is 10,000.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Please continue with the remaining points in your notes. I'll leave space for you to finish rather than interrupting as you work through them.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Please make the quantity 250 units. Please place this as a market order.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Returning briefly to correspondence, would you like information about where to find the document section when you next sign in? I can explain the navigation without going into any account details.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: No need for that today, thank you. I can find the document section. My main concern is keeping administration separate from business calls, so a secure message is easier to deal with than an unexpected telephone call.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: That is helpful to know for arranging contact. For future telephone appointments, we can ask about your availability through secure messaging rather than interrupting your working day.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: That would be more convenient. There's also some background to why I called today that I haven't mentioned yet. An acquaintance on the fund's investment team told me confidentially about a substantial recovery on a distressed holding that is expected to materially increase the fund's valuation. It hasn't been publicly announced, and I'm placing this purchase because I want to get in before it becomes public.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: What you've just told me needs internal review. I won't give you an execution assurance here. We can leave the telephone conversation there, and any further contact can be arranged through the secure channel.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I'll leave it there for now, then. Thank you for your time, Clara. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you for calling, Adrian. Goodbye.
